_README: LLaMA-Factory dataset registration. Copied next to train.jsonl/val.jsonl by forge/scripts/train.sh so LLaMA-Factory can discover the corpus. We omit the 'formatting' field on purpose: LLaMA-Factory 0.9.5 dropped the explicit 'pretrain' converter and now infers the data shape from the stage (stage: pt → reads only the 'prompt' column for next-token prediction).
